_doc: Brand leak guard config (ADR-0031). Run: node scripts/brand-guard.mjs --src | --artifacts.
forbidden: brand strings of any tenant; the list is IDENTICAL in villas-be-core, mo-reservation-fe, mo-packages and tm30-helper — change all four together.
allow / allowLines / exclude: every entry must say why the string never reaches a user. No skip flag exists by design.

src._doc: Everything that ends up in app.asar (package.json build.files) plus the public-facing repo docs and CI (release notes are generated there). Comments are NOT stripped: app.asar ships the files as they are.

artifacts._doc: The files electron-builder packs into app.asar, read from package.json build.files (node_modules is third-party and never scanned). Comments are NOT stripped.

allowLines.reason: electron-builder appId is the install identity (upgrade path, protocol registration); ADR-0031 Guidance keeps it unchanged. It is not shown in any window
